_meta.usage: region name in Hangul on a commercial plate (taxi, bus, truck), alone or with the rest: 서울, 서울 70바 1234, 부산 12사 3456
_meta.note: The region is where the vehicle was registered. Since 2004 private cars carry no region (12가 3456, 123가 4567); construction equipment plates dropped it from 2022-11-26 and new motorcycle plates from 2026-03-20. Commercial plates still show it; older private (before 2004), motorcycle and construction plates still on the road show it too (motorcycles also add the district, so they miss here). How plates for the merged 전남광주통합특별시 will read after 2026-07-01 is not in the sources; 광주 and 전남 plates stay valid.
_meta.miss_note: no region name: a private plate (2004 on), a military or diplomatic plate, an older motorcycle plate (region + district, e.g. 서울 관악 가 1234), or not a Korean plate
source: https://ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/대한민국의_차량_번호판 (2004 national plates without region; 세종 added; construction plates without region from 2022-11-26)
